title: Inference fault attribution and SLO alarm matrix
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a canonical attribution layer and alarm matrix that maps runtime error modes (timeouts, overload, model inference errors, HTTP/gRPC codes) to SLOs and on-call alerts. The deliverable is a set of dashboards and pipelines that: 1) normalize and enrich traces/metrics/logs with a standard "fault_reason" tag, 2) produce a concise alarm severity matrix that routes alerts based on customer-impact and confidence, and 3) provide drill-down dashboards that show time-to-detect, time-to-recover, and root-cause attribution across the serving stack (edge, router, model shard, runtime kernel). This ticket focuses on design, instrumentation changes, alert thresholds, and the initial dashboards for runtime-1.20 rollout.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical fault_reason taxonomy defined and reviewed (timeouts, overload, model_error, kv_cache_miss, grpc_4xx, http_5xx, rpc_deadline_exceeded, hardware_fault)
Tracing hooks added at ingress/router/runtime and model executor to attach fault_reason and shard_id for sampled and error traces
Metrics pipeline normalizes and emits a fault_reason metric series and a per-route latency histogram usable by SLOs
Alarm matrix implemented in PagerDuty/Datadog with severity mapping and dedup rules; no noisy P0 alerts during synthetic load test
Dashboard views: overall fault mix over time, per-model error slope, top contributing routes, and a 30/90/365-day incident heatmap
Automated RCA tagger prototype that correlates trace spans + logs to suggest top-2 root causes in the incident timeline

2026-02-07 - Ethan Zhao: Merged PR #3456 to add fault_reason tag in runtime agent and PR #3479 to normalize HTTP/gRPC codes to our internal taxonomy. Load test showed dedup rules reduced alert noise by ~72%.

2026-02-12 - Maya Patel: Running pilot on staging with runtime-1.20; observed a new model_error subtype (nan-in-output) that was not previously classified. Created follow-up ENG-45145 to add model-onboarding checks.
2026-02-15 - QA (Anita Shah): Dashboard U/X passes smoke tests; however, latency histogram cardinality needs roll-up to hourly for long-term retention. Added task to optimize roll-up policy.
notes: Implementation notes: Use OpenTelemetry for span propagation; enrich spans at edge with client_country and route_hash. Fault_reason must be a low-cardinality tag. For model_error subtypes, write a small normalized mapping table in infra-config so model teams can extend without code deploys. Alarm deduping will be implemented by grouping on route_hash + fault_reason + time_window(2m). Ensure histogram buckets match SLO targets and are exposed as prometheus summaries and OTLP metrics. Plan to run two-week staging pilot with synthetic traffic that exercises overload and deadline conditions before we enable alerts in prod.
